stock.description: Minth Group Limited, established in 1992 and headquartered in Jiaxing, China, functions as an investment holding company with a broad scope of business activities. Its core operations revolve around the design, development, production, processing, and distribution of passenger car body parts and associated molds, serving markets in China, the United States, Japan, Thailand, Germany, and Mexico. Beyond its primary automotive components business, Minth Group demonstrates significant diversification. The company manufactures and develops crucial electric vehicle (EV) components, such as batteries and motor systems, and also produces complete electric vehicles, buses, and modified cars. Its manufacturing capabilities further extend to optical parts, various metal molds, automation machinery, software, and production line solutions. Minth Group's extensive portfolio also includes import and export trading, wholesale of packaging materials, logistics services, and technology import. It is involved in the trade and manufacturing of metal products, the production and sale of electrical and electronic equipment, and the design, development, and trade of robotic systems. Furthermore, the company provides a range of services, including bookkeeping, customer service and market development, agricultural services, and management consulting, in addition to offering automobile glass and light metals casting.
